visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width video player embedded in a content section
visualCharacteristics.layout: Single 16:9 responsive box spanning the content column; optional poster with a centred play button that swaps in the player on click

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell: optional poster image, then a link to the video. Supported: YouTube (watch, shorts, embed, live, youtu.be; t/start honoured) via youtube-nocookie, and Vimeo (including unlisted hash) via player.vimeo.com. With a poster the player loads on click; without one it loads lazily when scrolled near. Link text (or the poster alt) becomes the iframe title. Any other URL renders as a plain link

usage.description: Standalone full-width YouTube or Vimeo video.

reuseGuidance: Use for a video on its own row (heading and text as default content above it). For text beside a video use columns-video.
